610338df14f4cebede6d1bb7ae7c1333ab864e87.summary: CrowdStrike's adversary profile describes SCATTERED SPIDER as a prolific eCrime actor conducting financially motivated activity since early 2022. Its early campaigns reportedly targeted customer relationship management and business-process outsourcing firms, plus telecommunications and technology companies. The page lists community aliases and regions: United States, United Kingdom, Western Europe, North America, Americas and Europe. The text is truncated and mostly page navigation and marketing.

6178af43d7884d2d3a98e745ade5ef63b16941fa.summary: Arch Linux wiki documentation on systemd timer units, a scheduling alternative to cron. It covers realtime and monotonic timers, calendar syntax, transient timers, template units and desktop notifications. It describes no threat actor, malware, vulnerability or incident, so this is not a threat report.
